decisions.decision: Keep Sprint Circuit and add Drag Sprint as a second Corse variant
decisions.rationale: User explicitly wanted the new straight-road race as a variant, not a replacement.

decisions.decision: Drag Sprint is lane-based head-to-head on a fixed straight road
decisions.rationale: Approved design: 3 fixed lanes, no random track tilt, clearer party-game readability.

decisions.decision: Support three host-selectable Drag Sprint modes: finish-line, best-of-3, survival
decisions.rationale: User explicitly requested all three modes.

decisions.decision: For Task 3 only, make Drag Sprint startable exclusively in finish-line mode
decisions.rationale: Best-of-3 and survival are future tasks; current branch needed a raceMode-aware gate instead of the temporary game+variant-only helper from Task 2.
